issue_context.title: Optimization for lightning conflict detection
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
1. Merge conflict record tables for preprocess duplicate detection and post-import conflict detection.
2. Performance optimization for post-import conflict detection.

Merge lightning preprocess duplicate detection and post-import conflict detection:
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/51036

Optimize lightning conflict recording tables:
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/52393

review_comments:
it's easy to get deadlock as worker pool is of fixed size, suppose pool size is 1
- for the first split of worker 1, we can send to the channel
- the task send loop get a task but it cannot start another routine
- then worker 1 try to split another time, we cannot send

The code structure is copied from `RemoveAllConflictKeys` in v7.5
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/e406d5780b18a1f2aaf6230cde4b6403991e228d/br/pkg/lightning/errormanager/errormanager.go#L452-L530

This case will not happen because:
For step 1 and 2, there is no problem.
For step 3, if worker 1 fails to send the new task to `indexTaskCh`, it will go to `default` to execute `indexTaskWg.Done()` instead of sending the task, which will not cause deadlock.
there is another potential point to improve performance, we can use "batch get" to retrieve the result.
